module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.null_resource.update_trust_policy: explicit depends_on of module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.kubernetes_namespace.spark is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_self_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng: explicit depends_on of module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_self_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_iam_instance_profile.self_managed_ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_self_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng: explicit depends_on of module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_self_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_iam_role.self_managed_ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.managed_ng duplicates the direct attribute-reference dependency: node_group.managed_ng already reads that role's ARN.
The explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution is redundant because update_trust_policy directly interpolates the role ID in its local-exec command.
The explicit depends_on on kubernetes_namespace.spark is redundant because update_trust_policy directly interpolates the namespace ID in its local-exec command.

The explicit dependency on aws_iam_instance_profile.self_managed_ng duplicates the dependency already carried through the referenced launch-template module output, whose configuration uses this instance profile.
The explicit dependency on aws_iam_role.self_managed_ng duplicates the dependency already established through the referenced launch-template module and its instance-profile configuration.
The explicit dependency on module.aws_eks duplicates the transitive dependency through data.http.eks_cluster_readiness, which reads data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster and already waits for the EKS module.
The explicit dependency on module.aws_eks duplicates the transitive dependency through data.http.eks_cluster_readiness, which reads data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster and already waits for the EKS module.
The explicit dependency on the managed node group's IAM role is already established by node_role_arn referencing that role's ARN.
The Auto Scaling group already depends transitively on the IAM instance profile through the launch-template module configuration and output; the direct explicit edge duplicates that ordering.
The Auto Scaling group already depends transitively on the IAM role through the instance profile and launch-template module; its direct explicit edge to the role duplicates that ordering.

The root Kubernetes-addons module is not gated on the managed node group becoming available. This example provisions add-ons that expect a usable EKS data plane, and its data_plane_wait_arn input is left at its empty default rather than being wired to the node-group output. Make the module wait for the managed node group before deploying add-ons.
